title: Tell me about your staircases
content: Stairs are always a big feature in any of my mall world dreams, whether it's the school/mall/hotel/etc I spend a lot of time going up and down stairwells There's a secret one, ALWAYS They are rarely one straight forward set of stairs but the kind that wind in a rectangle They're usually metal or concrete Sometimes I'm being chased but they usually feel like a safe space or a good way to get away from whoever is chasing me There's one particular thin and all white staircase that goes up a tower to a secret room, I haven't been there for a while
